cards.headline: The video was shot at Alexandra Palace
cards.snippet: Four Tet's "Teenage Birdsong" was released in July 2019 as the first song shared from his album "Sixteen Oceans", months before the record was officially announced. NME reported that its video was filmed at Alexandra Palace in London on May 9, 2019. The album, announced in early 2020 with its tracklist, was Four Tet's first since 2017's "New Energy".

cards.headline: Critics called it an 'infatuated banger'
cards.snippet: In its March 2020 review of Four Tet's "Sixteen Oceans", Paste Magazine called "Teenage Birdsong" an "infatuated banger." The reviewer noted that it sits in the middle of a four-song run: it follows the harpsichord-led "Harpsichord" and leads into the delicate "Romantics," then "Love Salad." Paste said this stretch shows the album's elegant sequencing, building a clear emotional arc from sounds and song titles alone.
cards.context: Paste's review of Sixteen Oceans, March 2020.

cards.headline: Overmono's remix of Teenage Birdsong, released on Text Records
cards.snippet: Overmono remix released on 2019-12-09 via Text Records and posted on Four Tet's own channel. It runs 4:38 and reworks the track with drums and a sample that listeners noticed.

cards.headline: Four Tet, Fred again.. & Skrillex mashup with a DnB edit of Teenage Birdsong
cards.snippet: A Coachella 2023 live mashup that blends Four Tet's Baby with Skrillex and Fred again.. tracks and acapellas, and ends in a DnB edit of Teenage Birdsong.
